intro: Parishuddhathmuda is the Christian Telugu song from the album, Premaku Prathiroopam Yesayye released in 2005 written and tuned by Bro Philip Gariki, sung by Sharon Sisters, Bro Philip Gariki, J K Christopher and music composed by renowned Telugu christian music director, J K Christopher. This song video was released on August 31, 2020 through Philip Sharon YouTube Channel.
